1	# Model Collapse — Research Skill (25 papers, 2026-05-20)
2	
3	## Experimental Design Consensus
4	
5	**Three canonical loop types**: (1) Replace (fully synthetic), (2) Augmentation (synthetic + fixed real), (3) Accumulate (keep all). Test at least replace vs accumulate. 5-10 generations standard; replace collapses by gen 3-5. **7/8 papers**. Source: Alemohammad "Go MAD" (ICLR'24). High.
6	
7	**Multi-domain validation**: Top venues expect collapse across model families (diffusion + LLM + analytical/Gaussian). 2-3 model types minimum. **6/8**. High.
8	
9	## Metrics
10	
11	**Image**: FID + Precision/Recall (k=5 NN). **Text**: perplexity + diversity (TTR, Distinct-n). **Rising**: entropy-based diagnostics (He2025: entropy-generalization r=0.91, beats variance). Spectral analysis of Gram matrices also emerging (SIGMA 2026). **4/25 recent**. Medium.
12	
13	**Diversity hierarchy**: syntactic > lexical > semantic degradation speed. Source: Guo (NAACL'24). **2/8**. Medium.
14	
15	## Datasets & Baselines
16	
17	**Image**: MNIST, CIFAR-10, FFHQ (32×32 or 128×128). **Text**: TinyStories/BabiStories (small LM), Wikitext-103 (medium), HelpSteer2 (SFT). **Theory**: Gaussian/Zipf + ridge regression mandatory. **5/8**. High.
18	
19	## Core Theory
20	
21	**Strong collapse** (Dohmatob ICLR'25 Spotlight): Etest≃B+V+ζ, ζ=p₂²c² irreducible. Even 1% synthetic creates error floor. No mixing fixes this unless synthetic fraction→0. **3/25**. High.
22	
23	**Accumulation prevents divergence** (Dey ICML'24, Kazdan ICML'25): Replace diverges; accumulate stabilizes. Cardinality of real data > proportion (R²=0.59 vs 0.34). Synthetic helps only when real data scarce (≤1024 samples). **4/25**. High.
24	
25	**Scaling law** (Dohmatob ICML'24): E_test≍T^{-c}+k^{-c'}. Tail truncation (top-p, temperature) is mechanism. Mixing real data induces grokking. **2/8 foundational**. High.
26	
27	## Mitigation
28	
29	**Quality filtering fails for diversity**: RoBERTa-CoLA filter amplifies diversity decline — favors common samples. **2/8**. Medium.
30	
31	**Diversity-aware selection works**: greedy max-min-distance in feature space: FID 75.7→44.7 (He NeurIPS'25). DCES dynamic sampling also helps. **3/25**. Medium.
32	
33	**Fresh real data is the only robust remedy**: even 2% real triggers recovery. **6/25**. High.
34	
35	## Research Gaps
36	
37	- **Scale**: no collapse study on frontier models (>2B params)
38	- **Modality**: image and text studied separately; no cross-modal collapse work
39	- **RLHF**: only Gauthier2026 studies alignment loop collapse
40	- **Detection→action**: spectral/entropy diagnostics disconnected from practical mitigation

## Experimental Design Consensus

═══ 方向 1: Information-Theoretic Unification ═══
**现状**: S×R + Power Theory 是两个 disconnected 的 framework。
**突破**: 用 information theory 统一。
- 定义: MI(t) = I(p_t; p_{t-1})，consecutive generation 的 token distribution 之间 mutual information
- 论证: α=0 时 MI≈0 (independent sampling)；α=1 时 MI→∞ (deterministic chaining)
- Phase transition 对应: MI(α) 超过 finite-T detectability threshold
- S(α) = effective MI signal，R(α) = MI first/second moment structure，Power scaling = MI estimator 的 √T 性质
- 所有 framework 都从 **一个数学量 (MI)** 推出
**Cost**: ~3-5 hours worker，用 EXISTING checkpoints 计算 KL(p_t||p_{t-1})

═══ 方向 2: Mechanism via Distribution Moments (机械耦合 — D150 raised) ═══
**现状**: "entropy 领先 diversity 1 代" 是 observed fact, 但没机理解释。
**突破**: 数学上证明 entropy = function of variance moment, diversity = function of tail moment crossing 1/N threshold.
- 跟踪每代 token distribution 的 variance、kurtosis、tail mass

\subsection{Cross-Architecture Generalization}
\label{sec:generalization}

We evaluate the detection phase transition across 15 model-seed combinations spanning six families (Pythia, GPT-2, OPT, Qwen, SmolLM3, Padding-variant), scales from 345M to 6.9B parameters, and two training domains (WikiText-103, C4).
Table~\ref{tab:generalization} reports PermG forward detection at $\alpha{=}1.0$.
PermG forward significance reaches ${\geq}$6/8 in 13 of 15 conditions (87\%).
Two exceptions emerge: Pythia-1.4B seed~42 on WikiText (2/8), a seed-dependent outlier that recovers to 6/8 in seed~43, and SmolLM3-3B (3/8), where only ECE$\to$downstream pairs reach significance while entropy$\to$downstream pairs fail entirely (0/4; details in Appendix).
SmolLM3's token entropy exhibits non-monotonic oscillations across generations; this pattern violates the monotonic decline that Granger tests require.
The onset boundary $\alpha_c \approx 0.50$ at $T{=}10$ is architecture-independent: every family that achieves detection does so at or above this threshold, and none achieves reliable detection below it.

Replacing WikiText-103 with C4 yields the strongest detection observed: Pythia-1B reaches PermG fwd 8/8 (both seeds), and Pythia-1.4B reaches 8/8 on C4 versus 2/8 on WikiText at the same scale.
At Pythia-6.9B (bf16), detection recovers to 7/8 on WikiText.
Dataset characteristics modulate detection power independently of model capacity.
Directional asymmetry shows preliminary domain variation: in one C4 seed-condition pair ($\alpha{=}0.50$, s42), PermG reverse reaches 7/8, but this is seed-dependent (s43: 1/8) and we note it as a preliminary observation requiring further investigation (\S\ref{sec:discussion}).

# 审稿报告 — "A Detection Phase Transition in Iterative Model Collapse"

**Venue**: EMNLP 2026 (ARR May cycle) | **Round**: 3 (Fresh Review) | **Reviewers**: 2 | **日期**: 2026-05-20

> ⚠️ **Deadline 差异**：EMNLP 2026 官方 ARR 提交截止日为 **May 25, 2026**（非提交者所称的 June 15）。今天 May 20，仅剩 5 天。请确认目标 cycle。

---

## Summary

论文研究迭代训练中 model collapse 的 Granger 因果检测，发现 permutation Granger causality (PermG) 在 per-generation mixing ratio α_c≈0.50 处从 0/8 跳跃到 6/8 FDR-significant pairs，称之为"检测相变"。提出 S×R 解释框架、MMCT 五方法共识测试、跨 15 model-seed 组合验证（87%），并展示 proof-of-concept 干预实验（peak perplexity 降低 58%）。方法论意识和鲁棒性检查在 model collapse 文献中属上乘，但核心发现受 power-vs-signal 混淆、MMCT 循环论证和不可证伪预测等系统性问题制约。

---

## Strengths

**S1. 方法论意识出色 [共识]。** 论文精准识别 lead-lag 分析中的三大陷阱（伪回归、方法敏感性、regime 依赖性）并逐一用数据回应。First-differencing 分析（canary→perplexity 消除 F≈0 p=0.99，canary→diversity 保持 24/24→24/24）是干净且有信息量的发现，在 model collapse 文献中罕见。

**S2. 全面的鲁棒性检查 [R1]。** Permutation count stability（5K vs 10K，max|Δp|=0.010）、FDR threshold sensitivity（null 在所有阈值均为 0/24）、observation window sensitivity（T_min≥5 即稳定）、specification curve（1,160 specs）。这种程度的 robustness 分析在该领域不常见。

**S3. 诚实的 claim scoping [共识]。** 始终澄清 Granger precedence ≠ causation（§5¶1），将 claims 限定在 diversity metrics（排除 perplexity），承认 partial mechanical coupling 不能完全排除（§5¶2）。MMCT 自标注为 "consensus testing protocol, not a novel statistical method"（§3）。

**S4. 跨架构验证有广度 [共识]。** 6 个模型家族（Pythia、GPT-2、OPT、Qwen、SmolLM3、Padding-variant），345M-6.9B 参数，两个训练域（WikiText-103、C4），15 个条件中 13 个确认检测（Table 2）。

**S5. MMCT 作为诊断工具有实际价值 [R2]。** 比较五种 lead-lag 检测方法在同一数据上的表现（Table 1），揭示分析选择对结论的敏感性——naive cross-correlation 有 75% null-control FPR，而 PermG 是唯一在所有 α 水平保持零 FPR 的方法。Shapley 值分解（App O）提供方法选择的定量依据。

---

## Weaknesses

### CRITICAL

**C1. "检测相变"实质是统计功效曲线穿越阈值 [R1-N1 + R2-W1, 强共识]**

两位 Reviewer 独立发现并互认。§4.2 自承 "the onset reflects PermG's power curve crossing the detection floor, not the emergence of a new physical signal"。Appendix N power analysis 显示 T=10 β₅₀=2.0（需强耦合才达 50% power）。Appendix D Table 7 的 FDR sensitivity 数据进一步支持：q=0.01→0/24, q=0.05→19/24, q=0.10→24/24——α_c 随 q 平滑移动，是 power curve 而非相变。Sigmoid fit R²=0.969 对近乎二值因变量（{0%, ~75%}）预期中即高。标题和全文使用 "phase transition"（物理学中有精确含义：对称性破缺、序参量非解析性）构成 overselling。

**C2. MMCT 设计存在循环论证 [R1-N2, R2 交叉 AGREE]**

FPR-inverse weighting 给 PermG w=1/ε=100, naive XCorr w≈1.33——75× 权重差异使 MMCT 本质上被 PermG 主导。论文随后用 MMCT 得出 PermG 最优——结论已被权重设计所保证。Shapley analysis（App O）在同一权重体系内运行，不是独立验证。需测试 weight-cap 或 equal-weighting 下结论是否改变。

**C3. First-differencing power loss confound 未解决 [R1-N3, R2 交叉 AGREE with mitigation]**

消除 canary→perplexity 保留 canary→diversity 的替代解释：如果两个 channel effect size 不同，power loss 可选择性消除弱 channel。R2 补充缓解因素：p≈0.99 的断崖式变化（而非渐进失去显著性）不完全符合纯 power loss 预期——但需 channel-specific effect size 比较作为正式检验。

**C4. 干预实验严重不足 [R1-M4 + R2-W2, 共识]**

n=2 models, 仅 α=1.0（full replacement——最不现实的场景），15% threshold "selected post hoc" 无 sensitivity analysis, bootstrap CI [29%, 64%] 较宽。作为论文明确列出的四项贡献之一（§1 bullet 4），证据基础不匹配。

**C1: "Phase transition" = power curve crossing threshold**

[severity: critical] Round 3 Action Matrix 独立评估 + t20_predictions 数据 bug

---

## 一、紧急 Bug：t20_predictions_locked.json α=0.60 使用了 pre-FDR 数据

`t20_predictions_locked.json` 生成于 10:50 UTC，在 FDR 修复（~14:00 UTC）之前。

**α=0.60 的 t10 输入数据错误**：
- 文件记录：`permg_counts[α=0.60] = 3`，`t10_rate_used = 0.375`
- FDR 修正后实际值：`dose_response_d120_compiled.csv` 中 α=0.60 s42 fp32 v4 → `permg_count = 0`（0/8）

α=0.60 的 T=20 预测（predicted_rate=0.326, predicted_range=[2,3]）基于错误输入，需要重新生成。修正后 T=20 预测应为 ≈0（无信号则无 power gain）。

**此 bug 不影响 α=0.45/0.50/0.75/1.00 的预测**，因为这些使用 sigmoid fit 参数。但 α=0.60 直接使用 actual rate，因此受 FDR 修复影响。

---

## 二、Round 3 各项修正方案评估

### C1: "Phase Transition" → "Detection Onset"

**判定：同意修正，方向正确。**

FDR 修正后的数据实际上让经验现象更锐利了（α≤0.45: 0/8 → α=0.50: 6/8，一步跳跃），但这并不构成物理相变。Round 3 引用的证据很有力：
- FDR sensitivity 表显示 α_c 随 q 平滑移动（q=0.01→0/24, q=0.05→19/24, q=0.10→24/24）
- Appendix N power analysis 已经自承是 power boundary
- Sigmoid R²=0.969 对近乎二值因变量预期即高

**建议标题**："Sharp Detection Onset" 比 "Detection Phase Transition" 更准确，且保留了核心发现的冲击力。"Power boundary" 过于技术性，不适合标题。

### C2: MMCT Weight-Cap 实验

**判定：方案可行但不充分，需补充 equal-weighting baseline。**

仅测试 w≤10 可能不够——如果 cap 从 100 降到 10，PermG 权重仍比 naive XCorr（w≈1.33）高 7.5×。审稿人会追问"为什么是 10 不是 5？"

**建议实验设计**：
1. Equal-weighting（w=1 for all）— 最干净的 ablation
2. FPR-inverse with cap w≤10
3. FPR-inverse with cap w≤5
4. 原始设计（w≤100）

如果 equal-weighting 下 PermG 仍排第一（Shapley v3 显示 PermG 在 K≥3/K≥4/K≥5 共识计数上也领先，这些不受权重影响），则循环论证攻击被有效反驳。

**关键：这是纯计算任务，不需要新实验。** 重新计算 Shapley 值用不同权重方案，分钟级完成。

### C3: First-Differencing Channel Effect Size

**判定：方向正确，补充我的独立证据。**

本 session 审查 α=0.55 时发现：8/8 forward AND 8/8 reverse diff_xcorr 均显著，但 PermG 0/8（F-stats 38-362，p_fdr 0.062-0.092）。这个模式支持"power loss"而非"signal absent"的解释——F-stats 显示信号存在，只是 FDR 在 8 对中控制假阳性时吃掉了 borderline 案例。

**但 R2 的缓解论点也有道理**：canary→perplexity 从 p<0.05 断崖式到 p=0.99，不像渐进 power loss。纯 power loss 应该是 p 值随差分逐渐增大，而非一步跳到 0.99。

**需要的分析**：
1. 差分前 canary→diversity 和 canary→perplexity 的 F-statistic 分布对比
2. 差分后同上
3. 如果差分前两个 channel effect size 就有数量级差异，则"选择性 power loss"解释成立
4. 如果差分前两个 channel 接近，p=0.99 cliff 则支持"真正消除伪相关"

同样是纯计算任务，重新分析已有 VAR 结果即可。

### C4: 干预实验降格

**判定：降格为 "preliminary observation" 是正确决策。**

当前证据基础（n=2, α=1.0 only, post-hoc 15% threshold, CI [29%, 64%]）确实不足以支撑 primary contribution。

**补充 threshold sensitivity（5%-25%）是必要的**，且是快速计算任务。

Multi-α 干预测试（如 α=0.50）需要新实验，但如果降格为 preliminary，则不再是硬需求。

---

### J1: T=20 预测移至 Discussion

**判定：同意，但需注意 T=20 实验进度。**

当前 T=20 进度（westd-17855）：
- a050: 19/21 generations（即将完成）
- a100: 18/21（即将完成）
- a060: 16/21
- a075: 14/21
- a045: 10/21

**如果 a050 和 a100 在投稿前完成**，可以报告初步验证结果。但鉴于 α=0.50 的 CI=[0,7] 几乎涵盖所有结果，只有 α≥0.75 的 CI=[6,8] 是真正可证伪的。a075 目前 14/21，完成尚需时间。

**无论 T=20 是否完成，移至 Discussion 作为 hypothesis 都是正确的论文定位。**

### J2: S×R → Interpretive Lens

**判定：同意。**

S×R 是 z-test power formula 的领域特化实例化。描述性价值在于解释 sync dip（α=0.60），但不构成独立理论框架。明确标注为 interpretive lens 消除了新颖性攻击面。

**注意**：如果论文转向 "Moment Cascade" 作为 Direction 2，S×R 的角色可能进一步缩减。

### J3: Seed 覆盖

**判定：这是最大的实验债务。**

FDR 修正后的数据让 seed 问题更严重了：
- α=0.75：s42=6/8, s43=5/8, s44=0/8（FDR 后）。方差极大，均值从 0.667 降到 0.458。
- α=0.10：s43=3/8 仍然显著（FDR 后）——在 α=0.10 这个理论上不应检出的水平，单 seed 异常值直接动摇 blind zone boundary。
- 5/13 α 水平单 seed。

**优先级排序**：
1. α=0.10 multi-seed（最关键——异常值需要确认或排除）
2. α=0.75 已有 3 seeds 但 s44=0/8 是离群值，需要解释
3. α=0.50 已有 3 seeds (6,6,6)，稳定

### J4: FPR CI

**判定：trivial，加上即可。** Rule-of-three 95% CI = [0%, 12.5%]，一行文字。

### J5: 87% Headline 失败分析

**判定：需要做，是写作任务不是实验任务。**
- SmolLM3-3B: ECE-only canary，canary metric 选择是 sensitivity dimension
- Pythia-1.4B s42: 2/8 vs 其他 seeds 6/8，seed-dependent

两种不同的失败机制值得一段分析而非脚注。

### J6: α=0.60 Sync Dip

**判定：T=20 a060 实验（当前 16/21）有望部分回答此问题。**

fp32 0/8 vs bf16 8/8 的翻转是一个真问题。如果 T=20 fp32 下 α=0.60 仍为 0/8（或接近），则 sync dip 是 robust phenomenon（至少在 fp32 下）。如果 T=20 变为显著，则 T=10 的 0/8 是 power 不足而非真 dip。

---

## 三、Deadline 核实

**[severity: critical] 必须立即确认 ARR cycle。**

Round 3 报告称"EMNLP 2026 ARR 提交截止 May 25"（5 天后），但：
- 项目配置只写了 `venue: emnlp-2026`，无具体 deadline
- ARR 有多个 cycle（通常 Feb/Apr/Jun/Aug/Oct）
- 如果目标是 ARR June cycle，deadline 通常在 June 15 前后
- 如果是 ARR May cycle，May 25 可能正确

**如果 May 25 是硬 deadline**：当前方案大部分可行（C1/C2/C3/C4 的修正都是写作+计算任务，不需要新训练实验），但 J3（multi-seed 补充实验）来不及，T=20 验证也只有 a050/a100 可能完成。

**如果 June 15 是 deadline**：所有修正均有充足时间，包括 T=20 全部完成、部分 multi-seed 补充。

**请 Director 立即确认目标 ARR cycle 和 deadline。** 这决定了修正方案的范围。

---

## 四、3.0 → 3.5 路径评估

Round 3 提出的 6 步修正路径是合理的。我的独立评估：

| 修正 | 难度 | 影响 | 5天可完成？ |
|------|------|------|------------|
| C1 reframe | 低（写作） | 高 | ✓ |
| C2 weight-cap | 低（计算） | 高 | ✓ |
| C3 effect size | 低（计算） | 中 | ✓ |
| C4 降格 | 低（写作） | 中 | ✓ |
| J1 T=20→Discussion | 低（写作） | 中 | ✓ |
| J3 multi-seed | 高（新实验） | 高 | ✗（部分可做） |

**关键判断**：C1+C2+C3+C4 四项 CRITICAL 修正全部可在 5 天内完成（均为写作或计算任务）。这四项修正直接回应了 Soundness 2.5 的主因，有潜力将 Soundness 提升到 3.0-3.5。

**3.5 的最大障碍是 J3（seed 覆盖）**：FDR 修正后 α=0.75 三 seed 中 s44=0/8 的离群值、α=0.10 s43=3/8 的异常值，都需要解释或补充数据。纯写作（承认 limitation + 讨论 seed variance）可以部分缓解，但不如补数据有力。

**总结**：如果 deadline 是 5 天，聚焦 C1-C4 四项 CRITICAL + J1/J2/J4/J5 写作修正，J3 在 Limitations 中诚实承认并承诺 camera-ready 补充。这条路径有望达到 3.5 (Borderline Conference)。如果 deadline 是 June 15，可以更从容地补充 multi-seed + T=20 验证，更有把握。

- a050: 19/21 generations（即将完成）
- a100: 18/21（即将完成）
- a060: 16/21
- a075: 14/21
- a045: 10/21

**如果 a050 和 a100 在投稿前完成**，可以报告初步验证结果。但鉴于 α=0.50 的 CI=[0,7] 几乎涵盖所有结果，只有 α≥0.75 的 CI=[6,8] 是真正可证伪的。a075 目前 14/21，完成尚需时间。

**无论 T=20 是否完成，移至 Discussion 作为 hypothesis 都是正确的论文定位。**

### J2: S×R → Interpretive Lens

**判定：同意。**

S×R 是 z-test power formula 的领域特化实例化。描述性价值在于解释 sync dip（α=0.60），但不构成独立理论框架。明确标注为 interpretive lens 消除了新颖性攻击面。

**注意**：如果论文转向 "Moment Cascade" 作为 Direction 2，S×R 的角色可能进一步缩减。

### J3: Seed 覆盖

**判定：这是最大的实验债务。**

FDR 修正后的数据让 seed 问题更严重了：
- α=0.75：s42=6/8, s43=5/8, s44=0/8（FDR 后）。方差极大，均值从 0.667 降到 0.458。
- α=0.10：s43=3/8 仍然显著（FDR 后）——在 α=0.10 这个理论上不应检出的水平，单 seed 异常值直接动摇 blind zone boundary。
- 5/13 α 水平单 seed。

**优先级排序**：
1. α=0.10 multi-seed（最关键——异常值需要确认或排除）
2. α=0.75 已有 3 seeds 但 s44=0/8 是离群值，需要解释
3. α=0.50 已有 3 seeds (6,6,6)，稳定

### J4: FPR CI

**判定：trivial，加上即可。** Rule-of-three 95% CI = [0%, 12.5%]，一行文字。

### J5: 87% Headline 失败分析

**判定：需要做，是写作任务不是实验任务。**
- SmolLM3-3B: ECE-only canary，canary metric 选择是 sensitivity dimension
- Pythia-1.4B s42: 2/8 vs 其他 seeds 6/8，seed-dependent

两种不同的失败机制值得一段分析而非脚注。

### J6: α=0.60 Sync Dip

**判定：T=20 a060 实验（当前 16/21）有望部分回答此问题。**

fp32 0/8 vs bf16 8/8 的翻转是一个真问题。如果 T=20 fp32 下 α=0.60 仍为 0/8（或接近），则 sync dip 是 robust phenomenon（至少在 fp32 下）。如果 T=20 变为显著，则 T=10 的 0/8 是 power 不足而非真 dip。

## 三、Deadline 核实

**[severity: critical] 必须立即确认 ARR cycle。**

Round 3 报告称"EMNLP 2026 ARR 提交截止 May 25"（5 天后），但：
- 项目配置只写了 `venue: emnlp-2026`，无具体 deadline
- ARR 有多个 cycle（通常 Feb/Apr/Jun/Aug/Oct）
- 如果目标是 ARR June cycle，deadline 通常在 June 15 前后
- 如果是 ARR May cycle，May 25 可能正确

**如果 May 25 是硬 deadline**：当前方案大部分可行（C1/C2/C3/C4 的修正都是写作+计算任务，不需要新训练实验），但 J3（multi-seed 补充实验）来不及，T=20 验证也只有 a050/a100 可能完成。

**如果 June 15 是 deadline**：所有修正均有充足时间，包括 T=20 全部完成、部分 multi-seed 补充。

**请 Director 立即确认目标 ARR cycle 和 deadline。** 这决定了修正方案的范围。

---

## 四、3.0 → 3.5 路径评估

Round 3 提出的 6 步修正路径是合理的。我的独立评估：

| 修正 | 难度 | 影响 | 5天可完成？ |

**3.5 的最大障碍是 J3（seed 覆盖）**：FDR 修正后 α=0.75 三 seed 中 s44=0/8 的离群值、α=0.10 s43=3/8 的异常值，都需要解释或补充数据。纯写作（承认 limitation + 讨论 seed variance）可以部分缓解，但不如补数据有力。

**总结**：如果 deadline 是 5 天，聚焦 C1-C4 四项 CRITICAL + J1/J2/J4/J5 写作修正，J3 在 Limitations 中诚实承认并承诺 camera-ready 补充。这条路径有望达到 3.5 (Borderline Conference)。如果 deadline 是 June 15，可以更从容地补充 multi-seed + T=20 验证，更有把握。

## 1. C2: MMCT Weight-Cap 实验（CRITICAL — 打破循环论证）

Reviewer 指出 MMCT 的 FPR-inverse weighting 给 PermG w=100 而 naive w≈1.33，使结论被权重设计保证。需要测试 4 种权重方案下 PermG 是否仍排第一。

**4 种方案**：
1. **Equal-weighting** (w=1 for all) — 最干净的 ablation
2. **FPR-inverse with cap w≤5**
3. **FPR-inverse with cap w≤10**
4. **原始设计** (w≤100, 即 1/ε with ε=0.01)

**对每种方案**：
- 重新计算 MMCT weighted consensus score W(X→Y) 对所有 pair
- 重新计算 Shapley values（5 methods × 32 coalitions）
- 报告每种方案下的方法排名 + PermG 的 rank 变化

**数据源**：使用 Shapley v3 的 48 experiments（去重后）
**关键预期**：Equal-weighting 下 K≥3 consensus 计数不受权重影响，因此 PermG 在共识层面应该仍然领先。但 Shapley combined 排名可能变化。

**产出**：`artifacts/mmct_weight_robustness.json` + summary table

## 2. C3: First-Differencing Channel Effect Size（CRITICAL — power loss confound）

Reviewer 质疑：差分消除 canary→perplexity 可能是 power loss 而非真正消除伪相关。需要 channel-specific 证据。

**分析**：
1. 差分前：canary→diversity 和 canary→perplexity 的 F-statistic 分布（α=1.0, 4 seeds）
2. 差分后：同上
3. 关键比较：如果差分前 canary→perplexity F-stat 就远小于 canary→diversity，则 power loss 解释不成立
4. 如果差分前两者可比但差分后 perplexity 断崖到 F≈0 p=0.99，则支持"消除共同趋势"解释

**数据源**：现有 5method_leadlag.json 中的 raw F-stats（差分前/后）
**产出**：`artifacts/channel_effect_size_comparison.json` + summary

## 3. C4: Intervention Threshold Sensitivity（补充 evidence）

当前 15% threshold "selected post hoc"。需要 sensitivity analysis。

**分析**：在 α=1.0 的 predictive intervention 实验中，测试 5 个 threshold 值（5%, 10%, 15%, 20%, 25%）：
- 每个 threshold 下：trigger generation、peak perplexity、recovery timeline
- 这是从现有 checkpoint 数据中重新计算，不需要新训练

**数据源**：intervention 实验的 per-generation metrics
**产出**：`artifacts/intervention_threshold_sensitivity.json` + summary

## 4. t20_predictions Fix（pre-FDR bug）

Reviewer 发现 `t20_predictions_locked.json` 的 α=0.60 输入使用 pre-FDR 数据（permg_count=3 → 实际 FDR 后 0）。

**修复**：
- 重新生成 predictions，使用 dose_response_d120_compiled.csv (v2 FDR) 的数据
- α=0.60 predicted rate 应从 0.326 降至 ≈0
- 其他 α 值使用 sigmoid fit 参数，不受影响，但也验证一遍
- 产出：`artifacts/t20_predictions_locked_v2.json`

## 5. Direction 2: Moment Cascade Analysis（Directive 32 — substance breakthrough）

用户要求探索机制性贡献。从现有 checkpoint 计算每代 token distribution 的 moment 统计。

**分析**（使用 Pythia-410M WikiText checkpoints，α=1.0, seed 42）：
1. 每代（gen 0-10）的 held-out token distribution 统计：
   - Entropy H(p)
   - Variance of log-probabilities Var(log p)
   - Kurtosis of log-probabilities
   - Tail mass: P(p < 1/V) where V=vocab size
   - Top-k concentration: sum of top-50 token probabilities
2. 对比不同 α 值（至少 α=0.00, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 1.00）
3. 绘制 moment cascade 图：哪些 moment 先变化、哪些后变化
4. 如果存在清晰的 variance↓ → kurtosis↑ → tail truncation → distinct_n↓ cascade，这就是 mechanistic explanation

**需要 GPU**：加载模型做 forward pass。每个 checkpoint 约 5-10 min inference。
**产出**：`artifacts/moment_cascade/` 目录下的 JSON + 图表

---

"A Detection Phase Transition in Iterative Model Collapse"

method.tex §Calibration 中 "PermG ... yield 0% FPR across 3 seeds (0/24 pairs)"：

"Theoretical characterizations of collapse mechanisms (Shumailov et al. 2024; Dohmatob et al. 2025) address complementary questions—when and why collapse occurs—rather than when it becomes statistically detectable from finite time-series data."

content.text:
This session is being continued from a previous conversation that ran out of context. The summary below covers the earlier portion of the conversation.

Summary:
1. Primary Request and Intent:
   The user (曹小玉) is PI of the `distrib_canary_collapse` project targeting EMNLP 2026 Main Track (ARR cycle, deadline uncertain: May 25 or June 15). The paper is "A Detection Phase Transition in Iterative Model Collapse." This session continued from prior context where Round 2 review was processed and Directive 30 was active.

   Key directives received this session:
   - **Directive 30 (carried over)**: Writing priority, no new experiments, keep running experiments untouched.
   - **Directive 31**: Decouple Paper Agent from Shapley v3 wait — dispatch ready writing items immediately, don't batch everything.
   - **Directive 32**: Research substance breakthrough — pursue 3 research directions (MI unification, Moment Cascade mechanism, Scaling Law) to elevate paper from 4.0 to 4.5+. "不要为了凑论文而写论文，要真正强的 method 和有贡献的研究."
   - **Round 3 Fresh Review processing**: Overall 3.0 (Findings). User expects full Holistic Pass + Per-Comment Action Matrix per the embedded protocol.

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - **Detection Phase Transition → Sharp Detection Onset**: Round 3 reviewers unanimously identify "phase transition" as overselling a power curve crossing threshold. Title must change.
   - **MMCT Circular Reasoning**: FPR-inverse weighting gives PermG w=100 vs naive w≈1.33 (75× gap), making MMCT conclusions predetermined. Need weight-cap and equal-weighting ablation.
   - **First-Differencing Power Loss Confound**: canary→perplexity elimination (F≈0, p=0.99) might be power loss rather than true null elimination. Need channel-specific effect size comparison.
   - **FDR Correction Bug (M048)**: dose-response compilation script read `significant` (pre-FDR) instead of `significant_fdr`, inflating PermG counts at onset/sync-dip. Fixed in v2.
   - **Shapley v3 dedup+FDR**: Excluded v3_d080/postd093/bf16 variants, deduplicated cross-server entries. PermG combined=-0.180 (best), rankings stable.
   - **√T Scaling**: Actual power scaling ≈T^(-1.1), faster than √T. √T is conservative lower bound. Power Analysis Monte Carlo confirms.
   - **α=0.75 FDR Impact**: s44 drops from 4/8 to 0/8 after FDR. 3-seed mean 0.458, high seed variability.
   - **α=0.55 "Power-limited non-detection"**: F-stats huge (38-362) but p_fdr=0.062-0.092. Distinct from α=0.60 "sync cancellation."
   - **S×R Framework → Interpretive Lens**: Downgrade from "theoretical framework" to "interpretive lens" per reviewer consensus.
   - **Direction 2 Moment Cascade**: Compute per-generation variance(log p), kurtosis, tail mass from existing checkpoints to provide mechanistic explanation for entropy→diversity lag.
   - **Direction 3 Scaling Law KILLED**: Only 1 α_c estimate (Pythia-410M Wiki T=10). Cross-architecture experiments are α=1.0 only — cannot estimate α_c per model. "30+ data points" was a miscount.
   - **t20_predictions_locked.json bug**: α=0.60 used pre-FDR permg_count=3 (actual FDR=0). Other α values use sigmoid fit parameters, unaffected.
   - **EMNLP 2026 Deadline Uncertainty**: Review report claims May 25 (ARR May cycle), project configured as June 15 (ARR June cycle). Must confirm with user.

3. Files and Code Sections:
   - **`/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0514_4/projects/distrib_canary_collapse/artifacts/dose_response_d120_compiled.csv`**
     - v2 FDR-corrected, 49 experiments across alpha_sweep/generalize/scale_check/intervention/ablation/padding
     - Critical corrected values: α=0.45 s42 permg 3→0, α=0.55 s42 permg 5→0, α=0.60 s42 permg 2→0, α=0.60 s43 permg 5→0, α=0.75 s44 permg 4→0
     - α=0.50: all 3 seeds = 6/8 (unchanged, unaffected by FDR)
     - diff_xcorr and perm_granger use `significant_fdr`; naive/threshold/ty use `significant` (no FDR field in JSON)

   - **`/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0514_4/projects/distrib_canary_collapse/artifacts/dose_response_d120_summary.md`**
     - Documents v2 FDR correction methodology, coverage (49 experiments), dedup rules, FDR impact table

   - **`/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0514_4/projects/distrib_canary_collapse/artifacts/shapley_v2/shapley_values_v2.json`**
     - Internally version "v3_dedup_fdr", 48 data sources, threshold_criterion=true_3sigma_d105
     - Main result (6-pair): PermG combined=-0.180 (best), diff_xcorr=-0.142, ty=-0.038, threshold=+0.074, naive=+0.203 (worst)
     - 8-pair robustness: PermG=-0.152, rankings identical
     - PermG FPR Shapley = 0.000 (exact zero, confirms FDR-corrected)

   - **`/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0514_4/projects/distrib_canary_collapse/docs/paper/experiments.tex`**
     - Line 62: Updated α=0.75 from "5--6/8 per seed across 3 seeds" → "0--6/8 per seed, 2 of 3 seeds ≥5/8" (Paper Agent decoupled batch)
     - Line 62-65: α=0.55 inserted as power gap between onset and sync dip
     - α=0.10 footnote added for s43 anomaly (3/8 vs 0/8)
     - Lines 14-15: Previously fixed α=0.45 from single-seed to dual-seed category
     - §4.4 Cross-Architecture: 15 conditions, 13/15 detection (87%), two exceptions analyzed

   - **`/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0514_4/projects/distrib_canary_collapse/docs/paper/method.tex`**
     - Line 15: "MMCT is a consensus testing protocol, not a novel statistical method"
     - Line 41: √T scaling hedged as "conservative lower bound"
     - Line 42: "This instantiates the standard z-test power formula"
     - Lines 41-48: Power formula, T=20 predictions, falsification tests

   - **`/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0514_4/projects/distrib_canary_collapse/docs/paper/introduction.tex`**
     - Lines 28-44: 4 contributions (will be restructured to 3 + preliminary observation)
     - Contribution 2 (S×R) will move T=20 predictions to Discussion
     - Contribution 4 (intervention) will be downgraded to non-numbered mention

   - **`/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0514_4/projects/distrib_canary_collapse/docs/paper/appendix.tex`**
     - 3 new sections added by Paper Agent: Per-Method Dose-Response (app:dose_response), PermG Power Analysis (app:power_analysis), Shapley Value Analysis (app:shapley)
     - Total appendix now 10 pages, paper total 18 pages

# Model Collapse — Writing Skill (8 deep-read papers, 2026-05-20)

## Narrative Archetypes

**Dominant: "破局型"** (5/8) — "Prior characterization X misses Y; we reveal mechanism Z." He2025: "variance too slow → entropy"; Dohmatob2025: "mixing should help → it doesn't". **Runner-up: "统一框架型"** (2/8) — "Contradictory conclusions resolve in different regimes." Kazdan2025, Dohmatob2024. High.

## Hook Strategies

**"Data crisis" opening** (5/8): Cite specific numbers — "17T tokens" (Guo), "ChatGPT=0.1% daily global words" (Dohmatob2024), "LAION-5B already contains synthetic images" (Alemohammad). High.

**Memorable analogy**: Alemohammad's "mad cow disease" is the field's most cited hook. Coin terms: "MAD", "Strong Model Collapse", "generalization-to-memorization transition" — papers that name phenomena get cited more. **4/8**. Medium.

**Paradigm challenge**: Dohmatob2025 targets scaling laws directly ("Within the paradigm underpinning ChatGPT and Llama..."). High stakes framing. **2/8**. Medium.

## Intro Structure

**3-5 paragraphs**: P1=crisis/context, P2=prior work + limitations, P3=our insight, P4=contributions (numbered). **Exactly 3 contributions** is standard. Verb-led: "We identify/establish/propose." First=observation, second=mechanism, third=method. **6/8**. High.

## Figure Design

**Figure 1 split**: teaser-result (3/8: Alemohammad faces, Dohmatob Pareto diagram) vs method-overview (3/8: He, Guo, Ba pipeline). Teaser for dramatic findings; overview for pipeline papers. High.

**Line plots dominate** (8/8): x=iterations/tokens, y=metric, multiple condition curves. Theory papers overlay dashed predictions on solid empirical — "pixel-perfect match" is gold standard. Source: Dohmatob2024, 2025. High.

**t-SNE for collapse** (3/8): scatter plots showing spatial compaction across generations. Use as supporting evidence alongside quantitative metrics. Medium.

**Figure narrative arc** (7/8): motivation/teaser → method → main results → ablation. Source: He2025, Alemohammad2024. High.

## Table Design

**This field is figure-driven** — 5/8 papers have zero numbered tables. When tables exist: methods as rows, datasets×metrics as columns, bold-best. High.

**Ablation prefers line plots over tables** (6/8): continuous parameters (λ, mixing ratio, filter threshold) shown as curves, not grids. High.

## Key Rhetorical Moves

**"Even X% is enough"**: Dohmatob2025's "as little as 1%" is the field's most impactful claim. Quantify minimum threshold — more memorable than showing collapse at 100%. High.

**Dual-evidence panels**: qualitative (images, t-SNE) + quantitative (curves) in same figure. He2025 Fig2 (nearest-neighbors + GS curves), Dohmatob2024 Fig4 (scaling + skill emergence). **5/8**. High.

**Theory-experiment overlay**: dashed theory + solid experiment on same axes. The closer the match, the stronger the paper. **3/8 theory papers**. High.

# Model Collapse — Research Skill (25 papers, 2026-05-20)

## Experimental Design Consensus

**Three canonical loop types**: (1) Replace (fully synthetic), (2) Augmentation (synthetic + fixed real), (3) Accumulate (keep all). Test at least replace vs accumulate. 5-10 generations standard; replace collapses by gen 3-5. **7/8 papers**. Source: Alemohammad "Go MAD" (ICLR'24). High.

**Multi-domain validation**: Top venues expect collapse across model families (diffusion + LLM + analytical/Gaussian). 2-3 model types minimum. **6/8**. High.

## Metrics

**Image**: FID + Precision/Recall (k=5 NN). **Text**: perplexity + diversity (TTR, Distinct-n). **Rising**: entropy-based diagnostics (He2025: entropy-generalization r=0.91, beats variance). Spectral analysis of Gram matrices also emerging (SIGMA 2026). **4/25 recent**. Medium.

**Diversity hierarchy**: syntactic > lexical > semantic degradation speed. Source: Guo (NAACL'24). **2/8**. Medium.

## Datasets & Baselines

**Image**: MNIST, CIFAR-10, FFHQ (32×32 or 128×128). **Text**: TinyStories/BabiStories (small LM), Wikitext-103 (medium), HelpSteer2 (SFT). **Theory**: Gaussian/Zipf + ridge regression mandatory. **5/8**. High.

## Core Theory

**Strong collapse** (Dohmatob ICLR'25 Spotlight): Etest≃B+V+ζ, ζ=p₂²c² irreducible. Even 1% synthetic creates error floor. No mixing fixes this unless synthetic fraction→0. **3/25**. High.

**Accumulation prevents divergence** (Dey ICML'24, Kazdan ICML'25): Replace diverges; accumulate stabilizes. Cardinality of real data > proportion (R²=0.59 vs 0.34). Synthetic helps only when real data scarce (≤1024 samples). **4/25**. High.

**Scaling law** (Dohmatob ICML'24): E_test≍T^{-c}+k^{-c'}. Tail truncation (top-p, temperature) is mechanism. Mixing real data induces grokking. **2/8 foundational**. High.

## Mitigation

**Quality filtering fails for diversity**: RoBERTa-CoLA filter amplifies diversity decline — favors common samples. **2/8**. Medium.

**Diversity-aware selection works**: greedy max-min-distance in feature space: FID 75.7→44.7 (He NeurIPS'25). DCES dynamic sampling also helps. **3/25**. Medium.

**Fresh real data is the only robust remedy**: even 2% real triggers recovery. **6/25**. High.

## Research Gaps

- **Scale**: no collapse study on frontier models (>2B params)
- **Modality**: image and text studied separately; no cross-modal collapse work
- **RLHF**: only Gauthier2026 studies alignment loop collapse
- **Detection→action**: spectral/entropy diagnostics disconnected from practical mitigation
